description: Official motion excerpts for PersonaVlog and Hunyuan-Game. FaithfulFaces uses its separate comparison manifest.

encoding.dimensions: Each preview has its own size field.

previews.paper: PersonaVlog: Personalized Multimodal Vlog Generation with Multi-Agent Collaboration and Iterative Self-Correction
previews.design_rationale: A continuous 6.75-second interval from official example 03, featuring the same black-haired woman quietly sketching beneath a tree, then walking and turning her head in a green woodland. Keeps the single native source cut at 16.25 seconds and all original motion timing; no rapid montage, speed-up, added transition, synthetic motion or talking-head loop. Landscape closeups preserve the face, pen gesture and surrounding foliage. The official page only offers animated examples, so this calmer female example replaces the exaggerated male park scenes.

chapters.selection_rationale: Calm sketching closeup; small coherent pen movement, stable facial silhouette and gently moving hair. No eating or exaggerated gestures.
Same protagonist walking through the woodland and gently looking to the side. This is the next original shot, retained at its native timing.

previews.poster_selection: Open-eyed, relaxed woodland portrait at original 17.8125s; the subject is framed by green trees and soft yellow light, with no baked-in text.

motion_review.review_method: Reviewed all 108 consecutive original frames at native 16fps across the entire 6.75-second selection, plus full-source contact sheets from all six public examples. Final output is sampled at 24fps without interpolation.
motion_review.findings: Stable hair/face proportions and small consistent pen movement. No new facial distortions, abrupt pose jumps, malformed large hand gestures or object crossings identified in this selected interval. One native scene cut is intentional. Underlying source is animation, not photorealistic footage.

previews.paper: Hunyuan-Game: Industrial-grade Intelligent Game Creation Model
previews.design_rationale: 6.8-second game montage: dramatic silver-haired closeup, pink-violet illustration effects, then bright futuristic portrait and heart gesture. Short cuts keep original model motion at native speed. One transparent image-to-motion cue introduces the relationship without a reference card.

chapters.selection_rationale: Dramatic eye lift, silver hair and controlled dark lighting, with the face centrally composed.
chapters.fit: Center cover to 720×432, preserving native aspect ratio

chapters.selection_rationale: Rich pink-violet effects, flowing fabric and petals around a finely rendered game illustration.

chapters.selection_rationale: Bright silver-haired character, luminous city background and a clear heart-shaped hand gesture.

rebuild: python3 scripts/build_identity_game_motion.py --source-dir /path/to/empty/directory; missing official assets are downloaded and their recorded SHA-256 hashes checked automatically. --fetch-only verifies this without rendering.
review_notes: Inspected original footage and final subject crops. PersonaVlog now uses the calmer official female example 03 with all 108 consecutive selected source frames reviewed, retaining one native scene cut. No new motion synthesized or playback speed-up. Other preview selection details remain documented per item.
